A concise "주가 차이 20,000원 · 동일 기준일" is an illustrative PROPOSED derived readout (not a claim that a historical price-spread service already exists). Do not invent a 괴리율 추이 chart or claim investment attractiveness. Current price comparison is not the historical cap comparison.
For MARKETCAP pages, core history chart must show THREE simultaneously visible labeled lines over SAME dates: 기업 등록 종목 합계 / 삼성전자 보통주 / 삼성전자우 우선주.
